The '''Polar Plateau''' on [[Telos IV]] was located in the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] polar regions. Massive and featureless, the [[Water/Legends|ice]] plateau was a mesa in which the [[Telosian Jedi Academy]] was built by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Atris]], the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] leading [[Jedi historian|historian]].<ref name="KOTOR CG" /> The Academy was built from the [[Telos Polar Irrigation System]], which supplied fresh water to nearly every [[City/Legends|city]] on Telos from the distant polar regions prior to its abandonment in the aftermath of the [[Bombing of Telos IV]].<ref name="TSL" />
